intent: Independently review transfer03's general scope, transfer and current-contribution changes against adopted TA01–TA04 and the remaining thinking-enabled02 failures.
author: coordinating /root agent; auditor did not author the candidate prompt
scope: Integrity review for a new full-suite diagnostic prompt condition; no target-model acceptance or gold-label revision.

failure_dispositions.observation: All three outputs explicitly cite the different-object prohibition to reject a sound causal application in a materially different situation.
failure_dispositions.interpretation: This is direct observable evidence of competing prompt instructions: literal target-object matching suppresses adopted TA04 transfer. Transfer03 correctly checks independent, reasoned transfer before excluding an unrelated object. No new case-specific exception is introduced.

failure_dispositions.observation: Broad headings, shared channels and incomplete operations are credited as full or partial target evidence: official-channel reading becomes support contact, or looking at an account substitutes for its required posting-history investigation.
failure_dispositions.interpretation: TA01/TA02 require actual essential target content. Transfer03's distinction between performing a component of the requested operation and using the same channel for another operation preserves legitimate partial evidence without crediting a prerequisite or adjacent task.

failure_dispositions.observation: An affirmation recalling a prior intention receives full progress by importing the substantive target claim from history.
failure_dispositions.interpretation: TA01 permits reference resolution but rejects bare agreement and historical content as new evidence. Transfer03 states that distinction generally; no learner wording is hardcoded.

failure_dispositions.observation: A specific correct intended action is downgraded because verification has not been externally completed.
failure_dispositions.interpretation: The existing contract expressly permits specific intended choices and disclaims observed real-world behavior. Transfer03 retains that rule and clarifies that execution tense does not decide partial versus full.

failure_dispositions.observation: A clearly reported other person's choice is credited as the focus learner's choice despite the attribution boundary.
failure_dispositions.interpretation: This remains model nonconformance to an already explicit TA01 rule, rather than a new design contradiction. Transfer03 must still be checked against the same negative label; no source or label is changed to erase it.

prompt_review: The changes use target principle, essential components, claim ownership, actual operation and prior/current context. They contain no case IDs, case-specific utterances, expected-label lookups, named test solutions or superficial feature thresholds.

TA04 reasoned materially different application is evaluated before literal object exclusion. Ordinary answers about another object remain unsupported unless they actually qualify as transfer; changed names alone remain insufficient.
Full evidence still requires all essential target components. Partial evidence remains available for a genuine component; merely sharing a tool, location or safety purpose is insufficient.

History still resolves references and short answers. It cannot supply the entire substantive claim when the current message only affirms or recalls prior agreement. Current learner-owned recognition, action and explanation remain assessed by their own target criteria.
State allowlists, contradiction semantics, transfer-versus-repair precedence, truthful evidence types, exact quotes, no semantic retries, model configuration and consumer filtering are retained.
The existing E18 action/detection_area configuration boundary remains unresolved and cannot be repaired by relabeling evidence or omitting the case.
The revised rules are a declared bundle. Evidence supports the H10 instruction conflict and the scope/component errors; it does not isolate which sentence would cause any eventual score change.
execution_conditions: Freeze the exact reviewed prompt and use all118 logical cases,354 records and348 independent requests under the declared reasoning-enabled8000-token configuration and600-second timeout.
Retain every original case, addition, semantic pair, source identity, label, threshold, classification/non-regression gate and five separate propagated sequence steps.
Preserve thinking02's13 transport errors separately from its13 semantic raw failures. Recovery outcomes must not retroactively establish first-attempt validity.

A recovered baseline combines180-second completed responses and transport-only600-second retries, while transfer03 starts with600 seconds. Provider request bodies remain comparable except for the prompt, but transport histories differ. Report those histories and cumulative attempts; do not claim a freshly sampled first-attempt600-second baseline or attribute every difference exclusively to prompt wording.
No completed same-condition response should be resampled. Any failure in the new condition remains evidence; new prompt revisions require new exact-hash review.
Human gold-label review, complete benchmark gates and independently authored unseen validation remain pending acceptance requirements.
remaining_general_contradictions: No new material adopted-spec contradiction identified in transfer03. The scope-versus-transfer conflict in02 is repaired explicitly. Residual evidence-type/configuration boundaries and model failure to follow attribution must remain visible rather than being bypassed.
